description: SRV-CLI-010: CORS headers ride on configured 3xx redirects too. The reference's `--cors` branch sets headers via `setHeader` BEFORE serve-handler runs (`third_party/serve/source/utilities/server.ts:65-70`), so they survive the redirect path. irserve's CORS pass runs post-dispatch and skips no status class — unlike `apply_custom_headers`, which deliberately skips 3xx (`crates/irserve-core/src/custom_headers.rs:182`).
